title: 日本ダービーの後に・スポットライトは

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Despite her efforts, Nice Nature fails to catch up to Tokai Teio in the Japanese Derby.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Tokai Teio expresses her motivation to train even harder for the next race.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Nice Nature sees this and admires her, musing that Tokai Teio is truly worthy of being in the spotlight.
